description: Source code for the LayerHierarchy class and related hierarchy management in Android's surfaceflinger frontend, including traversal, sorting, and hierarchy updates.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy
classes.description: Represents a hierarchy of layers, supporting traversal, sorting, and hierarchy management.

classes.name: LayerHierarchyBuilder
classes.description: Builds and manages the layer hierarchy, handling addition, removal, and updates of layers.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy::TraversalPath
classes.description: Represents a traversal path within the layer hierarchy, including clone and mirror information.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy::ScopedAddToTraversalPath
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily modify a traversal path during hierarchy traversal.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Traverses the hierarchy applying a visitor function.

methods.name: traverseInZOrder
methods.description: Traverses the hierarchy in Z-order applying a visitor function.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child layer to the hierarchy with a specified variant.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Removes a specified child layer from the hierarchy.

methods.name: sortChildrenByZOrder
methods.description: Sorts children based on their Z-order.

methods.name: updateChild
methods.description: Updates the variant of a child layer.

methods.name: hasRelZLoop
methods.description: Detects relative Z loops in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Returns the layer state associated with this hierarchy node.

methods.name: getRelativeParent
methods.description: Returns the relative parent of this hierarchy node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent of this hierarchy node.

methods.name: getDebugStringShort
methods.description: Returns a short debug string describing the hierarchy node.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns a detailed debug string of the hierarchy and its children.

methods.name: hasRelZLoop
methods.description: Checks for relative Z loops in the hierarchy.

methods.name: LayerHierarchyBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and manages the entire layer hierarchy, including adding, removing, and updating layers.

methods.name: attachToParent
methods.description: Attaches a hierarchy node to its parent.

methods.name: detachFromParent
methods.description: Detaches a hierarchy node from its parent.

methods.name: attachToRelativeParent
methods.description: Attaches a hierarchy node to its relative parent.

methods.name: detachFromRelativeParent
methods.description: Detaches a hierarchy node from its relative parent.

methods.name: attachHierarchyToRelativeParent
methods.description: Recursively attaches hierarchy nodes to their relative parents.

methods.name: detachHierarchyFromRelativeParent
methods.description: Recursively detaches hierarchy nodes from their relative parents.

methods.name: onLayerAdded
methods.description: Handles logic when a new layer is added.

methods.name: onLayerDestroyed
methods.description: Handles logic when a layer is destroyed.

methods.name: updateMirrorLayer
methods.description: Updates mirror layers for a given layer.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the entire hierarchy based on current layer states and destroyed layers.

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the root hierarchy.

methods.name: getOffscreenHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the offscreen hierarchy.

methods.name: getDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string for a specific layer id.

methods.name: getPartialHierarchy
methods.description: Returns a partial hierarchy for a specific layer id.

methods.name: getHierarchyFromId
methods.description: Retrieves hierarchy node by layer id, optionally crashing if not found.
